verdict.rationale: New Relic's Alerts platform lets users configure NRQL-based conditions with thresholds on any signal, and automatically notify/route issues to teams or systems when thresholds are breached, and newer vulnerability-management agent features can auto-trigger remediation actions like opening Jira/GitHub tickets. This directly matches 'rules that trigger actions automatically on events.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of custom action integrations (e.g., webhooks, arbitrary automation beyond ticketing/notifications) and broader detail on workflow automation configuration.
